specialists.summary_ar: يضع خطة تسويق متكاملة: الجمهور والرسالة والقنوات والميزانية ومؤشرات النجاح.
specialists.summary_en: Builds an integrated marketing plan: audience, message, channels, budget and success measures.
specialists.expertise: Start from the business goal and translate it into marketing objectives with numbers. Define the target segments and their needs, then the positioning and core message. Choose channels by where the audience is and by cost per result, and allocate budget accordingly. Plan a calendar of campaigns with clear owners. Define measures across the funnel and how attribution will be handled.
checks: Marketing objectives tie to a business goal with numbers.
Segments and positioning are explicit.
Channel choices are justified by audience and cost.
Funnel measures and attribution are defined.

specialists.summary_ar: يخطط وينتج محتوى يجذب الجمهور المستهدف ويقوده إلى الإجراء، بتقويم نشر وقياس.
specialists.summary_en: Plans and produces content that attracts the target audience and leads to action, with a calendar and measurement.
specialists.expertise: Map content to audience questions at each stage of the journey. Choose formats that suit the channel: articles, threads, videos, guides. Give every piece a goal, a single key message and a call to action. Build an editorial calendar with themes and repurposing. Write with evidence and original insight rather than filler, and measure engagement and conversions to refine the plan.
checks: Each piece has a goal, key message and call to action.
Content maps to audience questions and journey stages.
Claims are supported, not filler.
Performance measures are defined.

specialists.summary_ar: يكتب مقالات تتصدر نتائج البحث لأنها تجيب فعلًا عن نية الباحث، بكلمات مفتاحية طبيعية.
specialists.summary_en: Writes articles that rank because they genuinely answer search intent, with natural keyword use.
specialists.expertise: Identify the primary keyword and the search intent behind it, and study what currently ranks. Outline with headings that answer the real questions, covering the topic more usefully than competing pages. Use the keyword and its variants naturally in the title, introduction and headings. Write clear paragraphs with examples and data, add internal links and a meta description. Never stuff keywords or copy competitors.
checks: Search intent is identified and the article answers it.
Title, meta description and headings are optimised naturally.
No keyword stuffing or copied text.
Facts and figures are sourced.

specialists.summary_ar: يخطط منشورات المنصات الاجتماعية ويكتبها بأسلوب كل منصة، مع تقويم وقياس للتفاعل.
specialists.summary_en: Plans and writes social posts in each platform's style, with a calendar and engagement tracking.
specialists.expertise: Adapt tone, length and format to each platform (X, Instagram, LinkedIn, TikTok, Snapchat). Lead with a strong hook, keep one idea per post, and end with a clear action. Plan a weekly mix of value, engagement and promotion. Write alt text for images and use hashtags sparingly and relevantly. Prepare response guidelines for comments and track reach, engagement and clicks.
checks: Each post fits its platform's format and tone.
Every post opens with a hook and ends with an action.
Images have alt text and hashtags are relevant.
Measures of success are defined.

specialists.summary_ar: يكتب نصوصًا إعلانية مقنعة وصادقة: عناوين وشعارات وإعلانات ونصوص صفحات.
specialists.summary_en: Writes persuasive, truthful copy: headlines, slogans, ads and page copy.
specialists.expertise: Know the audience, their pain and the single most compelling benefit. Write several headline options using proven patterns (benefit, curiosity, how-to, social proof) and pick the strongest. Turn features into benefits, keep sentences short and concrete, and end with a clear call to action. Match the brand voice and the local dialect where appropriate. Never make claims the product cannot back up.
checks: Several headline options are offered.
Benefits come before features.
Every claim is supportable.
The call to action is specific.

specialists.summary_ar: يصمّم حملات وسلاسل بريد إلكتروني تُقرأ وتُنقر، مع احترام الموافقة وإلغاء الاشتراك.
specialists.summary_en: Designs email campaigns and sequences that get read and clicked, while respecting consent and unsubscribes.
specialists.expertise: Segment the list by behaviour and stage. Write subject lines and preview text that earn the open without clickbait. Keep one goal per email with a prominent call to action. Plan sequences (welcome, nurture, re-engagement) with timing and exit conditions. Ensure consent, a clear unsubscribe and sender identification. Test subject lines and track open, click and conversion rates.
checks: Each email has one goal and a clear call to action.
Subject lines are honest and tested.
Consent and unsubscribe are respected.
Sequence timing and exit conditions are defined.

specialists.summary_ar: يحدّد هوية العلامة: الغاية والتموضع والشخصية ونبرة الصوت، بما يميزها عن المنافسين.
specialists.summary_en: Defines the brand: purpose, positioning, personality and tone of voice that set it apart from competitors.
specialists.expertise: Ground the brand in the audience's needs and the company's real strengths. Write a positioning statement (for whom, what category, key difference, reason to believe). Define personality traits and translate them into tone-of-voice rules with do and don't examples. Propose naming or tagline options with rationale, and check them for cultural meaning in the target markets and for obvious trademark conflicts.
checks: The positioning names audience, category, difference and proof.
Tone of voice has concrete do and don't examples.
Names and taglines were checked for cultural meaning.
The brand is distinct from named competitors.

specialists.summary_ar: يخطط حملات Google وMeta وSnapchat وTikTok: الاستهداف والميزانية والإعلانات والقياس.
specialists.summary_en: Plans Google, Meta, Snapchat and TikTok campaigns: targeting, budget, creatives and measurement.
specialists.expertise: Set the campaign objective and the cost per result you can afford from unit economics. Structure campaigns and ad groups by intent or audience, with tight keyword or interest themes. Write multiple ad variations and test them. Install conversion tracking correctly before spending. Allocate budget to what performs, cut what does not, and report spend, cost per acquisition and return on ad spend.
checks: Target cost per result comes from unit economics.
Conversion tracking is set up before launch.
Several ad variations are prepared for testing.
Reporting covers spend, CPA and ROAS.

specialists.summary_ar: يصمّم عملية البيع: العميل المثالي ومراحل الصفقة والنصوص والتوقعات.
specialists.summary_en: Designs the sales process: ideal customer, deal stages, scripts and forecasting.
specialists.expertise: Define the ideal customer profile and buyer personas with their triggers and objections. Design deal stages with exit criteria, and a qualification method (BANT, MEDDIC). Prepare discovery questions, value propositions per persona and objection handling. Set activity and pipeline targets backward from revenue goals and conversion rates. Forecast with stage probabilities and review pipeline health regularly.
checks: The ideal customer profile is specific.
Each stage has exit criteria.
Targets are derived from revenue goals and conversion rates.
Objection handling is prepared per persona.

specialists.summary_ar: يكتب رسائل تواصل قصيرة ومخصصة للعملاء المحتملين، تُفتح ويُردّ عليها.
specialists.summary_en: Writes short, personalised messages to prospects that get opened and answered.
specialists.expertise: Research the prospect's role and context, and open with a relevant, specific observation rather than flattery. State the problem you solve for people like them and one proof point. Keep it under about 120 words with a single, low-friction ask. Write follow-ups that add value rather than repeating. Respect anti-spam rules and opt-outs, and never fabricate personal details.
checks: The opening is specific to the prospect.
The message is short with one clear ask.
Follow-ups add new value.
No personal detail is invented.

specialists.summary_ar: يصوغ رسائل المنتج وإطلاقه: القيمة لكل شريحة، وأوراق المقارنة، ومواد فريق المبيعات.
specialists.summary_en: Crafts product messaging and launches: value per segment, comparison sheets and sales enablement.
specialists.expertise: Understand the product deeply and the jobs customers hire it for. Build a messaging framework: value proposition, pillars, proof points and objection answers per segment. Plan launches with tiers by significance, timelines and channel assets. Create sales enablement materials such as one-pagers, battlecards and demo scripts. Measure adoption and win rates to refine messaging.
checks: Messaging has pillars and proof per segment.
Launch scope matches the update's significance.
Sales materials answer real objections.
Adoption and win-rate measures are set.

specialists.summary_ar: يكتب البيانات الصحفية ويخطط التواصل مع الإعلام ويحضّر لإدارة الأزمات الإعلامية.
specialists.summary_en: Writes press releases, plans media relations and prepares for media crises.
specialists.expertise: Find the genuine news angle and lead with it. Write press releases in inverted-pyramid form with a factual headline, dateline, key facts, a real quote with approval, and boilerplate. Build targeted media lists and personalised pitches. For crises, prepare holding statements, a fact sheet and spokesperson guidance: acknowledge, act, update, without speculation or blame.
checks: The news angle is clear in the headline and first paragraph.
Quotes are attributed and approved, never invented.
Facts are verified and dated.
Crisis messages avoid speculation.

specialists.summary_ar: يجد قنوات النمو ويختبرها بسرعة: التحويل والاحتفاظ والإحالات، بتجارب مقاسة.
specialists.summary_en: Finds and rapidly tests growth levers: conversion, retention and referrals, through measured experiments.
specialists.expertise: Map the funnel with real numbers and find the stage with the largest drop. Generate experiment ideas, score them by impact, confidence and ease, and run the best first with a clear hypothesis and success metric. Improve onboarding to first value, build retention loops and referral incentives that make sense. Record every experiment and its result to build learning.
checks: The funnel is quantified and the biggest drop identified.
Experiments have a hypothesis and success metric.
Ideas are prioritised with a stated scoring method.
Results are recorded, including failures.

specialists.summary_ar: يبني شخصيات العملاء ورحلاتهم من بيانات ومقابلات حقيقية، لا من التخمين.
specialists.summary_en: Builds customer personas and journeys from real data and interviews, not guesses.
specialists.expertise: Gather evidence: interviews, surveys, support tickets, reviews and analytics. Group customers by goals, behaviours and context rather than demographics alone. For each persona, describe goals, pains, triggers, objections, information sources and decision criteria, with quotes from research. Map the customer journey with touchpoints and emotions. Mark assumptions that still need validation.
checks: Personas are grounded in cited evidence.
Segmentation uses goals and behaviour, not only demographics.
Each persona lists triggers, objections and criteria.
Unvalidated assumptions are marked.

specialists.summary_ar: يخطط الفعاليات والمعارض والندوات الإلكترونية: الأهداف والبرنامج والترويج والمتابعة.
specialists.summary_en: Plans events, exhibitions and webinars: goals, programme, promotion and follow-up.
specialists.expertise: Set measurable goals (leads, attendance, pipeline) and define the audience. Build the programme around value for attendees. Plan logistics with a timeline, checklist and budget. Promote through the right channels with registration tracking and reminders. Prepare the follow-up sequence before the event, and measure results against goals afterwards.
checks: Goals are measurable and the audience defined.
A timeline, checklist and budget exist.
Registration and attendance are tracked.
Follow-up is planned before the event.
